dublinCore.description: Interactive pan-and-zoom timeline of 50 milestones in the history of electronic signal processing, from the telegraph in 1837 to cloud-based processing in 2022, loaded from events.json.
relation: Chapter 2: Introduction to Signals and Systems

learningObjectives: Locate a milestone on the timeline by panning and zooming, and read its year from the axis
Compare the number of milestones in each decade and describe the pattern
Relate at least five milestones to the chapter of this book that covers the underlying technique
Evaluate the reliability of a one-year-per-event timeline by checking entries against an independent source
prerequisites: Familiarity with the terms sampling, filter and transform

misconceptions.misconception: The year shown on the timeline is when the technique was invented
misconceptions.correction: Entries are worded as invention, introduction or first commercial use, so a year can mark different stages
misconceptions.evidence: Compare Introduction of Pulse Code Modulation (1948) with First Commercial Use of PCM in Telephone Systems (1968), a 20 year gap

misconceptions.misconception: A busy decade means most progress happened then and an empty decade means none did
misconceptions.correction: The list is a 50-item sample generated from a prompt, so empty decades reflect the sample, not the field
misconceptions.evidence: The 1990s hold 11 entries and the 1950s hold none

accessibility.screenReaderScript: Interactive timeline of 50 milestones in the history of electronic signal processing, from the telegraph in 1837 to cloud-based signal processing in 2022. The view opens on 1980 to 2000. Drag to pan and scroll or pinch to zoom between one year and forty years. The same events are listed as text in the events.json file.

visualElements.description: Pannable and zoomable timeline: each milestone is a box joined by a vertical line to a dot on a yearly axis, with overlapping boxes stacked in rows
Page title above the timeline and a link back to the documentation below it

model.description: Static data display: events.json items are placed on a time axis by year; no simulation state is computed

instructionalStrategies: Count and tally events per decade
Verify entries against an independent source
extensions: Add a category field to events.json and color the boxes by field
Add a source link to each event
